Scoring is the cut made across the top of a loaf just before it goes into a very hot oven. A single confident slash with a razor blade at a shallow angle lets the crust open into an ear. Oven spring, the fast rise in the first fifteen minutes, needs steam, so bake inside a preheated dutch oven with the lid on, then remove the lid to brown the crust. Weak spring usually means the dough was overproofed during [[Bulk fermentation]] or shaped without enough surface tension.
